highest_value_findings: The historical system replaced five fixed/pairwise schedulers with one central idle-driven dispatcher carrying daily quotas and exit reasons. This is a direct precursor for current research-center central lease/resource arbitration.

Centralization immediately exposed stringly outcome parsing and reload-idempotency bugs; scheduler state/outcomes must be typed and replay-safe rather than inferred from text prefixes or module side effects.

System events can be persisted/replayed in UI while deliberately excluded from LLM conversation context. Persistence, context admission, effect authority and UI affordance are distinct state dimensions.
Cancellation/user-return liveness had to penetrate actual inference calls and sleep intervals; cooperative cancellation must be modeled through blocking resources, not only logical task state.

Decommissioned voice/wallpaper services were explicitly removed from watchdog topology. Recovery must respect intended absence and lifecycle epochs rather than interpreting every stopped service as failure.
X11 DOCK/strut replaced hundreds of lines of competing topmost/fullscreen control, supporting a general law: delegate authority to one platform primitive when it can own the invariant.
Download known-state ordering silently lost notifications: eligibility/effect receipt must precede terminal known/admitted state.
Installer/service topology and memory docs are valuable architecture indices but require mechanical conformance to executable runtime before truth promotion.

branch_feedback.research_center: Use one typed central dispatcher/lease arbiter with quotas, priorities, outcomes and resource reservations; no pairwise worker exclusions as the primary mechanism. Make join/reload idempotent.
branch_feedback.harness: Add central-dispatch outcome parsing, reload duplicate-handler, persistent-system-event/context-separation, cancel-during-blocking-call, user-return-during-delay, removed-service-watchdog and known-state-before-effect regression fixtures.
branch_feedback.needle_claycode: Represent task outcome, cancellation token, scheduler quota, context admission and lifecycle intended-state as typed state/effects rather than strings or prompt conventions.
branch_feedback.unifieddb_rae: Persist event role, UI visibility, LLM-context admissibility, authority and replay affordances as orthogonal provenance fields. Preserve scheduler lifecycle epochs and intended absence.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Model central arbitration and platform-authority ownership edges; flag competing control loops that attempt to enforce the same invariant independently.
branch_feedback.deployment: Diff installer/service manifest against executable service registry and watchdog topology; removed services must be terminally absent rather than auto-recovered.

earned_work.reason: Strong architecture lineage overlaps existing scheduler/authority/replay mappings; final row-level dedup required.

level0_effect.reason: Commit-event semantic closure is a sub-denominator signal only; combined Level-0 denominator remains unfrozen.
